reasons: Full attack maps/hanging evaluation were costly. KingFast matches full king evaluation; choose exact bounded lazy evaluation, not the pressure cache. Diagnostic recommendations are not ground truth or a promotion criterion.

gates.depthGate: No median loss of at least one completed ply in two of three representative positions at1000ms. A failed gate prevents promotion even if screen scores well.
gates.correctness: Independent JS attack map, mirror and hidden-identity isolation, all root/per-world score equality to exact king evaluation, ASan/UBSan, TSan, independent replay and production checks if promoted.
gates.weights: Frozen before any game. No weights or variants changed after screen. Optional same-budget paired Pika comparison only after internal gates.
